description: Unit tests for skia image operations, including resizing, color averaging, and pattern drawing, using Google Test framework.

methods.name: AveragePixel
methods.description: Calculates the average pixel color over a specified rectangular region of a bitmap.

methods.name: AveragePixel
methods.description: Calculates the average color from an array of colors.

methods.name: PrintPixel
methods.description: Prints pixel values in a specified region for debugging.

methods.name: ColorsEuclidianDistance
methods.description: Computes Euclidean distance between two RGBA colors.

methods.name: ColorsClose
methods.description: Checks if two colors are close within a small threshold.

methods.name: FillDataToBitmap
methods.description: Fills a bitmap with a gradient pattern.

methods.name: DrawCheckerToBitmap
methods.description: Draws a checkerboard pattern into a bitmap.

methods.name: SaveBitmapToPNG
methods.description: Saves a bitmap as a PNG file (conditional compilation).

methods.name: CheckResampleToSame
methods.description: Verifies that resizing an image to the same size yields identical image.

methods.name: CheckResizeMethodShouldAverageGrid
methods.description: Tests that resizing produces pixel colors close to the expected average.
